magic.wandscape.beam.desc.zh_cn: 发射一道光束，每 tick 对目标造成正相关于光束宽度的伤害，无视无敌帧。光束不可穿透墙壁。
magic.wandscape.beam.desc.en_us: Fires a beam that damages the target every tick, scaling with the beam's width and ignoring invulnerability frames. The beam cannot pass through walls.

magic.wandscape.conversion.desc.zh_cn: 将最近的三个敌方单位转化为友军，持续一段时间；被魅惑的单位受到伤害后失去该效果。
magic.wandscape.conversion.desc.en_us: Converts the three nearest enemies into allies for a while; charmed units lose the effect upon taking damage.

magic.wandscape.desperation.desc.zh_cn: 将护甲降低至原来的 -50%（如 20 护甲值会降低到 -10），根据降低的护甲值提供魔力强化效果，提升魔法伤害。
magic.wandscape.desperation.desc.en_us: Reduces armor to -50% of its original value (e.g. 20 armor drops to -10), granting magic enhancement based on the penalty to boost magic damage.

magic.wandscape.enfeeble_field.desc.zh_cn: 在自身周围展开虚弱力场，使半径 5.8 格内的所有敌人陷入迟缓与虚弱，并削减护甲，持续 15 秒。
magic.wandscape.enfeeble_field.desc.en_us: Unfolds an enfeeble field, slowing and weakening all enemies within 5.8 blocks and shredding their armor for 15 seconds.

magic.wandscape.fortification.desc.zh_cn: 为自身施加防御强化：护甲 +4、魔力强化 I（魔法伤害 +20%）与迅捷 I，持续 15 秒。
magic.wandscape.fortification.desc.en_us: Fortifies the caster: +4 armor, Magic Enhancement I (magic damage +20%) and Speed I for 15 seconds.

magic.wandscape.heal.desc.zh_cn: 持续一段时间，治疗施法者周围一定半径内的友方单位。
magic.wandscape.heal.desc.en_us: Over time, heals friendly units within a radius around the caster.

magic.wandscape.meteor.desc.zh_cn: 法阵持续期间逐颗轰下六颗陨石，对落点附近的敌人造成群体伤害。
magic.wandscape.meteor.desc.en_us: Calls down six meteors one by one, dealing area damage to enemies near the impact points.

magic.wandscape.petrification.desc.zh_cn: 给予自身石化效果，受到的伤害降低 2 点。
magic.wandscape.petrification.desc.en_us: Grants the caster petrification, reducing damage taken by 2.

magic.wandscape.revive.desc.zh_cn: 在祭坛上唤醒一位死去的法师，使其以虚弱之躯重生。
magic.wandscape.revive.desc.en_us: Wakes a fallen mage at the altar, bringing them back in a weakened state.

magic.wandscape.teleport.desc.zh_cn: 将施法者瞬间传送到目标位置。
magic.wandscape.teleport.desc.en_us: Instantly teleports the caster to the target location.
